title: One Voice
description: Everyone shouts the same short line at the same instant — a wall of human voices, together. Swap the line for your message. No app extras needed; it repeats so latecomers still catch a round.

briefing.event: On the count, everyone shouts the SAME words at the SAME instant. Your phone only counts you in — put in an EARBUD or watch the screen so the street hears your VOICE, not your speaker. Never play the line through your phone.
briefing.notes: Change the line to your message. Two or three words land hardest. It repeats every few seconds, so people who just arrived can jump straight in.
briefing.exit: Toward the main street, normal pace.
briefing.abort: Stop chanting. Lower your phone. Walk to the exit at a normal pace.
